commits.message:
feat(docs): rich-strip's demo page runs in the card, with file tabs (rich-example-card-b5rz.hpj) (#358)

* feat(docs): rich-strip's demo page runs in the card, with file tabs (rich-example-card-b5rz.hpj)

A card's program is now a set of files, the entry first. A docs block is the
one-file case and shows no tabs; a demo shows a tab per file, every one
editable, imports between them resolved at run time, the program re-run on
edit. Reset restores every file; the playground link (format `files.`)
carries them all, and `card.` and bare links still open.

rich-strip is reshaped to the demo shape: `main.ts` is the entry for the card
and `npm run strip`, imports use published names, and the tour fits the
card's 75x24 terminal. Published names resolve to src/ through
PUBLISHED_PATHS in loadCompilerOptions (coverage, docs compiler) and
scripts/build-demos.ts (Node), both derived from ENTRY_BY_SPECIFIER.
demos.json records card and iframe demos; e2e drives rich-strip's card.
effects-playground's page script is renamed page.ts so main.ts means a demo.

* fix(docs): a demo is held at build to the check its card runs, and the file tabs are the ARIA tabs pattern (rich-example-card-b5rz.hpj)

Review (high) of #358:
- demoProgram runs refuseUnrunnable, now whole-program: the card's compile,
  and every import a library package or one of the program's own files. A
  relative import that leaves examples/ is refused naming the importer.
- oneSource is gone; every one-file program is programFiles(oneFile(...)).
- thrownAt reads Firefox/Safari `fn@file:line:col` frames.
- DEMO_ENTRY lives in demo-entry.ts so vite.config.demos.ts no longer loads
  the docs example pipeline.
- File tabs: roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End keys, editor as labelled tabpanel.
- package.json#devEngines asks contributors for a Node with unflagged type
  stripping (^22.18.0 || >=23.6.0), which scripts/build-demos.ts needs;
  engines.node, the consumer floor, is unchanged.

* fix(docs): a refused program says which file refused it, to the build and under the card (rich-example-card-b5rz.hpj)

Review (medium) of #358: the build named the entry and the card named no
file when a non-entry file was refused. PlaygroundProgram's refused arm now
carries at: { file, line | null }; the eval's refusal claims no line.
